name: Slideshow Multi Curtain
description: Full-screen image slideshow where colored curtain panels sweep across the screen between slides while the images slide out with a parallax tilt. Controlled by wheel, touch, drag or arrow buttons.
contents: Stack of colored curtain panels used for transitions
Scroll hint text and previous/next round buttons
behavior: Wheel, touch and pointer gestures move to the next or previous slide
Current slide exits with parallax and rotation while staggered curtain panels sweep across
Images are preloaded before the slideshow becomes visible
editableByProps: Images, number of curtain panels and their colors
Transition timing, easing, parallax, rotation and stagger
Hint text, navigation button visibility, size and colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Make the slides move vertically instead of horizontally
needsCodeEdit.where: xPercent tweens inside the navigate function

needsCodeEdit.change: Use arrow glyphs other than text arrows
needsCodeEdit.where: the two button elements with handlePrev and handleNext

fixed: Wheel, touch and pointer gestures on the slideshow area are captured for navigation
Slideshow fills the full viewport height
Component stays hidden until gsap loads and images preload
